 Unifree Duty Free unveils immersive K-Beauty concept at Istanbul Airport
 The new space showcases some of Korea’s most sought-after skincare brands, including Laneige, Anua and COSRX
 Share to LinkedIn By
 Hibah Noor
 No items found. The dedicated K-Beauty area at Istanbul Airport Unifree Duty Free has strengthened its beauty offer at Istanbul Airport with the launch of a dedicated K-Beauty area, introducing travelers to one of the world’s most dynamic and influential beauty categories.
 Designed with a fresh and contemporary aesthetic featuring soft pink tones and a welcoming atmosphere, the new space showcases some of Korea’s most sought-after skincare brands, including Laneige, Anua and COSRX. The dedicated area allows passengers to discover innovative beauty products and routines that have gained a strong global following in recent years.
 As K-Beauty continues to drive growth across international beauty markets, the new concept reinforces Unifree Duty Free’s commitment to bringing globally relevant trends to Istanbul Airport and creating engaging retail experiences for travelers from around the world.
 To celebrate the launch, Unifree Duty Free transformed the area into an interactive experience zone throughout October, hosting special K-Pop dance performances inspired by Korean popular culture. Accompanied by energetic K-Pop music, the performances attracted passengers passing through the terminal and added a vibrant entertainment element to the shopping journey.
 Anua is one of several brands featured in the K-Beauty concept Recognized for its innovation, ingredient-focused formulations and skincare-first philosophy, K-Beauty has evolved from a regional trend into a global beauty movement. By introducing a dedicated K-Beauty destination, Unifree Duty Free aims to provide travelers with access to some of the most in-demand brands and products shaping today’s beauty landscape.
 With its strong appeal among Generation Z and Millennial consumers, K-Beauty represents one of the most influential trends shaping today’s beauty industry. Through this concept, Unifree Duty Free aims to engage younger travelers while maintaining a diverse and inclusive offering that appeals to its broad international passenger base.
 The launch further strengthens Istanbul Airport’s position as a key travel retail hub where passengers can discover international beauty trends and premium retail experiences under one roof. As consumer interest in K-Beauty continues to grow, Unifree Duty Free plans to further strengthen its assortment through the introduction of new brands, ensuring travelers have access to the latest innovations and trends shaping the category.
 Ceren Tonguç, Chief Commercial Officer at Unifree Duty Free, commented, “At Unifree Duty Free, we continuously evolve our retail offering in line with emerging consumer trends and the expectations of our diverse international passenger base. The launch of our dedicated K-Beauty area reflects the growing global appeal of Korean beauty brands and our commitment to bringing the most relevant and sought-after concepts to Istanbul Airport.
 “By combining a curated brand selection featuring Laneige, Anua and COSRX with engaging cultural elements such as K-Pop performances, we have created a destination that goes beyond traditional retail. This initiative is part of our broader strategy to deliver innovative, experience-driven shopping environments that enhance the passenger journey and strengthen Istanbul Airport’s position as a leading global travel retail hub.”
